# Broomfield View

> Broomfield View is an independent local information site for Broomfield, CO. It is not a government agency and not a newsroom; official decisions and notices are the ones published by the local authorities themselves.
> Broomfield View gathers public information from the City and County of Broomfield, the National Weather Service, and the Colorado Department of Transportation. Pages are assembled automatically from those sources and checked by automated rules; no person reviews an individual item before it is published. Some descriptions of places and city projects were written with an AI model from the official pages they cite; we check them against those pages and remove what we cannot back up. No other text on the site is written by an AI model. Every news item and listing links back to its source. Collected twice a day; weather hourly.

Titles, dates, places and links on listings are taken from the named source above; each listing links back to it.

## City hall

- [City hall](https://broomfieldview.com/city-hall/): City council, county commission and committee meetings in Broomfield, in plain language.
- [Meeting archive](https://broomfieldview.com/city-hall/archive/): Every council and commission meeting we've covered, sorted by month.
- [Active projects](https://broomfieldview.com/city-hall/projects/): Track a real development or ordinance through every meeting that touches it.

## What's happening

- [Events](https://broomfieldview.com/events/): What's on in Broomfield -- library programs, city events and community happenings.
- [Today](https://broomfieldview.com/today/): What's actually happening right now -- weather, events and any open closures, in one glance.
- [This week](https://broomfieldview.com/this-week/): A day-by-day look at the week ahead: meetings, events and games, all in one place.
- [Concerts & shows](https://broomfieldview.com/whats-on/): Touring concerts, theater and festivals within driving distance, ranked by how big they actually are.

## Getting around

- [Traffic](https://broomfieldview.com/traffic/): Current road incidents and lane closures affecting Broomfield.

## Work and money

- [Workplace Watch](https://broomfieldview.com/workplace-watch/): Monthly review-trend digests for Broomfield's major employers -- check before your shift.
- [Jobs](https://broomfieldview.com/jobs/): Local job listings pulled daily, filterable by category.

## Local life

- [Vail Resorts newsroom](https://broomfieldview.com/vail-resorts/): Vail Resorts' own newsroom feed, collected here for Broomfield residents who work there, invest there, or just want to keep up.
- [Reviews](https://broomfieldview.com/reviews/): Reviews of what's currently playing locally.
